frontmatter.title: About the Department of Artificial Intelligence — Kathmandu University

chunks.heading: About the Department
chunks.text:
About the Department
The Department of Artificial Intelligence at Kathmandu University focuses on education, research, and innovation in the field of artificial intelligence. The department aims to develop skilled professionals capable of designing and deploying intelligent systems to solve real-world problems through quality teaching, practical learning, and research.

chunks.heading: Academic programs
chunks.text:
Academic programs
The department offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and research programs in artificial intelligence. The curriculum combines strong theoretical foundations with practical applications, laboratory work, and hands-on projects to prepare students for academic and professional careers.

chunks.heading: Areas of study
chunks.text:
Areas of study
Major areas of study include machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, computer vision, robotics, and AI ethics. The department promotes interdisciplinary learning and prepares graduates to contribute to sectors such as healthcare, finance, education, and technology.

chunks.heading: Research and collaboration
chunks.text:
Research and collaboration
The department places strong emphasis on research and innovation. It collaborates with national and international academic institutions and industry partners, providing students with opportunities to participate in innovative research projects and develop cutting-edge AI solutions.
